title: Golden Noise for Diffusion Models: A Learning Framework
tldr_zh: 10 万对反演噪声训练 NPNet，一次前传把随机噪声变黄金噪声；SDXL ImageReward 58.01→65.01
tldr_en: NPNet learns random-to-golden noise mapping from 100k re-denoise inversion pairs; plug-and-play, +0.4s, ImageReward 58.01 to 65.01 on SDXL.
key_numbers: Hunyuan-DiT fine-tuned with only 600 pairs: ImageReward 91.33 -> 100.82 (Table 3)
HPSv2 filter keeps 23.88% of noise pairs (Table 9); learned alpha=1e-4, beta=-0.0189 (Table 15)
Ablation w/o singular-value branch: ImageReward 49.03 < Standard 58.01 (Table 4)
